name: io.github.n-kostadinov/etoro-trading-mcp
title: eToro Trading MCP
description: 197 eToro API tools for agents: market data, watchlists, feeds, demo and real trading.

environmentVariables.name: ETORO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: eToro application public key (x-api-key); pair with ETORO_USER_KEY

environmentVariables.name: ETORO_USER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: eToro generated user key (x-user-key); pair with ETORO_API_KEY

environmentVariables.name: ETORO_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth bearer token; alternative to the key pair, never both

environmentVariables.name: ETORO_ENABLED_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable; every toolset is off by default

environmentVariables.name: ETORO_ALLOW_REAL_MONEY
environmentVariables.description: Set true to permit real-money mutations in addition to enabling their tools
